objects.name: bridge1
objects.description:
A simple wooden plank bridge crossing water, straight horizontal planks with rope
railings on both sides, sturdy wooden support posts, pixel art, Stardew Valley
style, cozy cottagecore color palette, low detail, clean simple outlines, flat
lighting, no drop shadow, no embossing, top-down 3/4 perspective, plain transparent
background
